description: We are a group of 6 girls and we want to create a game.
summary:
Galactic Mission is an interactive space exploration game designed for children aged 7–12. We developed a virtual Moon Base where players take on the role of astronauts and complete different missions and activities.

The game includes Moon Adventure, where players collect energy crystals, a Star Shop and Character Studio for customisation, Space School for learning interesting space facts, and Mission Control, where players make decisions that affect their mission. Players also manage important resources such as water, oxygen, food, power and health while learning about teamwork and astronaut safety.

Our project addresses the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge by giving children a fun and interactive way to experience some of the responsibilities and challenges of being an astronaut. It is important because it makes learning about space more engaging, encourages problem-solving and teamwork, and helps younger children become more interested in science and space exploration
details:
Galactic Mission is an interactive space exploration game designed for children aged 7–12. Players become astronauts and explore a virtual Moon Base while completing missions and learning about space.

The game works through different sections. In Moon Adventure, players move their astronaut, collect energy crystals and complete levels. In Mission Control, they make decisions that affect their mission. They can also explore different Moon Base locations, learn space facts in Space School, complete astronaut training activities, and look after their crew. The game also includes a Character Studio and Star Shop where players can customise their astronauts.

The main benefit of Galactic Mission is that it makes learning about space fun and interactive. It encourages problem-solving, decision-making, teamwork and curiosity about science. Our goal is to help younger children understand some of the challenges astronauts face and become more interested in space exploration.

We developed the game using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. We used GitHub to store our code and publish the game online, and Canva to create our presentation. We also used ChatGPT to assist with coding, improving features, debugging and organising information.

What makes our project creative is that it combines learning with gameplay. Instead of only reading about astronauts, children can experience a simplified version of a space mission themselves. While developing it, we considered the target age group, making the controls simple, the activities educational, and the design colourful and engaging.
